estimates: Event mass, initial climb/heading and weather are documented game presets.
Aerodynamic polar, water drag, buoyancy, moments, flooding and damage are tunable approximations.
Bridge/boat envelopes are schematic shared render/contact geometry.
Ordinary street blocks are not reconstructed to a 2009 survey; conspicuous modern tower silhouettes are suppressed.
River navigation anchors are rounded midpoints of bundled source-water cross sections, not recorded flight positions.
Version 3 aerodynamic/configuration and water-entry scoring coefficients are game calibration, not A320 operating limits.
Manual runway navigation and reach estimates include turn/alignment/energy margins; they do not guarantee touchdown or safe stopping.
Version 4 decision exposure costs and the TEB assessment gate are game estimates; no choice guarantees reachability or forces a physical outcome.
